preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in input for c in output)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output must exist in the input string.
Every character in the output must appear at least twice in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in output or input.count(c) >= 2 for c in input)
postconditions.description: If a character appears in the output, it must appear at least twice in the input; otherwise, it must not appear in the output.
